name: JK to Inkou Kyoushi 4 ~Namaiki Model Shoujo Hen~
original_name: JKと淫行教師4～なまいきモデル少女編～
source:
Takashi is a teacher. One day, two new students come to his class, Shizuka and Satsuki. Shizuka is friendly and Satsuki is quiet. Days later, vice-principal suddenly orders Takashi to take care of them. Shizuka is actually selfish and egoistic... "Oh, are you sexually stressed out...? Ok, Satsuki'll help you..."

[From ErogeShop]
